original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

first_step.inspect: Locate the selected packing source in the review and check live PRs for the same residual problem.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Define an unclaimed canonical domain and a favorable bound before starting a new search.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

actual_scope: Exact fixed-capacity packing relaxation of the top open claim PR #2917 (inventory {4:26,5:2,7:62,8:96,9:222}, local profile {1:2416,2:640,3:280,4:110,5:26,8:8}) and a literal owner-legal T74 allocation of its unchanged words that attains that relaxation optimum; complete fresh-native admission and modern outer release against the PR2917 headline.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a bounded improvement to the selected packing. The selected record (#1094) is far behind the open frontier; the unsearched, explicitly bounded packing instance with real headroom is the open-PR frontier word itself: PR2917 ships a fill 9.11e-7 below the exact fractional optimum of its own inventory (its own search stopped at a single-move fixed point). This package closes that residual exactly; it does not change the selected frontier.
bottleneck_link: A fixed word set has an exact packing cap. PR2917 realized 9.11e-7 less than its cap; this allocation realizes all of it (the complete profile equals the fractional optimum), so further gains on these words must change the words (inventory or local profile), not the fill.
stop_rule: Stop when a literal allocation of the unchanged words reaches the certified cap with owner-engine PASS and the complete admission passes strictly above the PR2917 headline, or report a scoped finding if any stage rejects it.
evidence: run_registered.py (stdlib): package pins; owner engine on the new allocation (271,728 roles, physical 66,804) and five rejection controls; PR2917 moment auditor re-pinned to the PR2917 headline; Fractions-only relaxation certificate and literal-profile equality; stored receipts binding. reproduce.py: exact Git exports of PR2908/PR2917 (and through them PR2894/PR2833), fresh retained bootstrap, PR2917 derived source (manifest 98d57c82), adapters, fresh native chains for both providers and complete admission: PASS_REPLICA_ORDER_FILL_DERIVATIVE_COMPLETE_RELEASE and PASS_RELEASE at the claimed kappa.
author: Marius-Paul Dumitrean
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance (Anthropic Claude via Claude Code) for search, implementation, exact computation and checks; no independent human review is claimed.

open_questions.question: Can the words of PR2917 be changed so that the fixed-inventory cap itself rises (further paired extractions on the final 82-endpoint word, or narrowings), and can each change be packed at its new cap?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This allocation exhausts the fill layer for these words: every further gain must lower the paid local profile or the width inventory. One more 9->8 extraction at PR2917-step-1 cost ({1:+3,2:-2}) is worth about +3.6e-7 after a cap-attaining re-pack.
open_questions.first_step: Recompute PR2908/PR2917 paired nullspaces on the final 82-endpoint word (existing and lowered terminal frames), price each nominee with the certified frame solver and certificates/RELAX-CAP.json-style relaxation for the changed inventory, then pack it with the same flow route.
open_questions.blocked_by: Search time; PR2917 stopped searching once its nine-step word was frozen.

open_questions.question: Is the flow-plus-doubling route a general constructor for every PR2917-lineage inventory?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The cap basis was integral per replica here, so no integrality residue remained; other inventories may need lockstep copies (PR2863) to reach their caps.
open_questions.first_step: Run construction/fill17.py with --catalogue tight on a changed inventory; if the integral basis mix has fractional multiplicities, combine with PR2863-style vacancy relays over copies.
open_questions.blocked_by: None for inventories with an integral optimal basis.
